verses.english: When the sky is rent apart,
then a soul shall know what it has sent ahead and left behind.

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.english: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord,
verses.transliteration_html: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
verses.transliteration_text: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi

verses.english: who created you and proportioned you, and gave you an upright nature,

verses.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.english: and composed you in any form that He wished?
verses.transliteration_text: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka

verses.english: No! Indeed, you deny the Retribution.
Indeed, there are over you watchers,
Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss,
and indeed the vicious shall be in hell,
entering it on the Day of Retribution,
and they shall not be absent from it.
And what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.english: Again, what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
verses.english: It is a day when no soul will be of any avail to another soul and all command that day will belong to Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
